theme: Hepatic fructose and alanine flux into gluconeogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe fructose breakdown and its inherited defects alongside alanine metabolism and gluconeogenesis, framed as carbon feeders converging via oxaloacetate on hepatic glucose production.

theme: Notch receptor activation and transcriptional signalling
core_role: The shared pathways cover the nuclear, transcriptional output of Notch signalling (NICD-driven target gene regulation and its developmental and T-cell uses), which the additional pathways feed by supplying receptor proteolysis and constitutive activation upstream.

theme: Plasma lipoprotein lipolysis, remodelling and clearance
core_role: The shared pathways describe VLDL assembly and the clearance of triglyceride-rich lipoproteins and LDL with cellular cholesterol uptake, framed as the downstream fate of particles that lipase-driven chylomicron remodelling produces.

theme: MECP2-mediated chromatin repression in neuronal function (Rett)
core_role: The shared pathways are MECP2's regulation of neuronal genes, its disease-causing loss-of-function defects and resulting sensory/behavioural phenotypes, framed as epigenetic transcriptional repression that works through NCoR/SMRT-HDAC deacetylation and neuronal mRNA control.

theme: MHC class I antigen processing and cross-presentation
core_role: The shared pathways are the MHC class I presentation machinery itself, covering endogenous and cross-presented exogenous antigen loading and CD8 T cell homeostasis, with ubiquitin-proteasome degradation supplying the peptides.

theme: p53-driven DNA damage checkpoint and G2/M control
core_role: The shared pathways describe the DNA damage response (radiation responses, TP53 stabilisation and activation, Cdc25A degradation, CDK inhibition, senescence), framed as checkpoint arrest whose release and mitotic re-entry the additional cell cycle pathways cover.

theme: M-CSF-driven osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption
core_role: The shared pathways describe osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption control, framed as a myeloid/macrophage fate driven by CSF1 and cytokine signalling.

theme: Ovarian folliculogenesis and gonadotropin control of ovulation
core_role: The shared pathways cover ovarian follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization and FSH/LH secretion, framed as the hormonally controlled female reproductive cycle within broader gonadal and germ cell maturation.

theme: Scavenger receptor-mediated clearance by macrophages
core_role: The shared pathways describe scavenger receptor classes taking up modified lipoproteins and immune complexes, leading to foam cell formation, framed as phagocytic clearance machinery that also recognises and engulfs apoptotic cells.

theme: Glycerolipid synthesis, remodelling and glycerol transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover phosphatidic acid, diacylglycerol and triacylglycerol synthesis and remodelling with aquaporin glycerol (and urea) transport, framed as the anabolic, storage side of glycerolipid turnover opposite lysophospholipid hydrolysis.

theme: Transition and heavy metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways describe zinc, copper, manganese and cadmium transport, metallothionein/MTF1 detoxification and responses to toxic metals, framed as general metal homeostasis alongside the iron/heme handling in the additional set.

theme: Translation termination and mRNA surveillance decay
core_role: The shared pathways are translation termination and ribosome-coupled mRNA quality control (nonsense-mediated, no-go and non-stop decay with stalled ribosome rescue), framed as surveillance of aberrant translation events.

theme: Vitamin D, phosphate and vitamin K bone-mineral regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe vitamin D activation and catabolism with its disorders, plus PTH-regulated renal phosphate homeostasis, framed as the endocrine mineral axis that works with FGF23-Klotho and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation to control bone mineralization.

theme: Cardiac chamber morphogenesis and myocardial development
core_role: The shared pathways describe ventricular and atrial myocardium growth, trabeculation, compaction and septation, framed as the muscular part of heart chamber formation alongside endocardial, septal and coronary vascular development.

theme: Hindbrain, cerebellar and basal ganglia development
core_role: The shared pathways describe brainstem/pons and cerebellar Purkinje layer development with motor learning and respiratory control, framed as maturation of motor-control regions of the brain together with striatal development.

theme: Reelin-regulated dendrite and spine development
core_role: The shared pathways cover dendritic spine and neuron projection maintenance and postsynaptic membrane organisation, framed as the structural dendritic outcome of reelin signalling.

theme: ER protein targeting and ER-Golgi trafficking
core_role: The shared pathways are secretory pathway entry and anterograde export: SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion into the ER, folding and ER retention, and COPII cargo loading toward the Golgi, balanced by COPI retrograde return.

theme: Heme biosynthesis and erythroid heme metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are the porphyrin/heme B biosynthetic route with iron-sulfur assembly and mitochondrial ABC transport, framed as heme supply for hemoglobin production.

theme: RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and its negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways describe RAF/MRAS activation, oncogenic MAPK mutants and the phosphatase-mediated negative feedback inactivating ERK, framed as the regulated core cascade downstream of SOS-driven Ras activation.

theme: Nephrogenesis and ureteric bud development
core_role: The shared pathways describe nephron formation from metanephric mesenchyme (renal vesicle, comma/S-shaped bodies, tubule patterning) with nephric duct and ureteric bud origins, framed as one half of reciprocal kidney induction alongside ureteric bud branching and collecting duct development.

theme: Zinc, manganese and iron transporter homeostasis disorders
core_role: The shared pathways describe SLC39 zinc/manganese uptake and ferroportin/ceruloplasmin iron export with their genetic diseases, framed as divalent metal transport that also carries toxic cadmium.

theme: Leukotriene and lipoxin eicosanoid metabolism in inflammation
core_role: The shared pathways cover leukotriene synthesis, transport, signalling and omega-oxidative catabolism with lipoxin metabolism, framed as the lipoxygenase branch of arachidonate-derived inflammatory mediators.

theme: Mitochondrial branched-chain amino acid and 2-oxoacid catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe leucine, valine, isoleucine and threonine catabolism, the biotin-dependent carboxylases and their inborn errors, framed as mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism run by lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes.

theme: Hepatic and muscle carbohydrate and glycogen metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe intracellular glucose, fructose and glycogen metabolism with gluconeogenesis and their storage diseases, framed as the post-absorptive fate of hexoses taken up via intestinal digestion and transport.

theme: Hepatic glucose production and fructose metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe gluconeogenesis, G6P transport/hydrolysis, glucokinase regulation and fructose catabolism with their disorders, framed as liver glucose output balanced against glycogen turnover.

theme: Notch intracellular domain transcriptional signalling and oncogenic activation
core_role: The shared pathways describe NICD-driven Notch target gene transcription and its regulation, framed as the output that constitutively active NOTCH1 mutants and FBXW7 loss amplify in cancer.

theme: Oncogenic RAS-RAF-MAPK signalling and ERK feedback
core_role: The shared pathways describe negative regulation and feedback inactivation of the ERK cascade, framed as the restraint on MAPK signalling that oncogenic RAS, BRAF and RAF1 mutants override.

theme: RIG-I/MDA5 viral sensing and type I interferon response
core_role: The shared pathways cover cytosolic RNA sensing via RIG-I/MDA5, TRAF3/6-IRF3/7 and NF-kB activation, ISG15 and viral evasion, framed as the sensing step that drives the type I interferon antiviral signature.

theme: Early kidney development and regulation of nephrogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe pronephros, mesonephros and nephric duct formation with control of metanephric development and kidney size, framed as early kidney organogenesis restrained by apoptosis and proliferation control in nephrogenic mesenchyme.

theme: Endosomal nucleic acid sensing by TLR7/8/9
core_role: The shared pathways describe TLR7/8/9 signalling, its regulation by TREX1 and SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5, and defective self-ligand handling, framed as nucleic acid-driven innate immunity alongside cGAS-STING and interferon-beta responses.

theme: Vascular tone and blood pressure regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe NO-cGMP signalling, vasoconstriction and vasodilation, and renal sodium and fluid control of arterial pressure, framed as regulation of vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation.

theme: Antimicrobial peptide defence at mucosal surfaces
core_role: The shared pathways describe defensins, metal sequestration and membrane-disrupting killing of bacteria and fungi, framed as humoral innate defence that also shapes host-microbe interactions.

theme: Neutral amino acid and imino acid transport
core_role: The shared pathways cover plasma membrane transport of neutral amino acids, proline, glycine and tryptophan and Hartnup disorder, framed as renal/intestinal amino acid absorption whose defects cause aminoacidurias.

theme: NGF-TRKA signalling to MAPK and transcription
core_role: The shared pathways describe TRKA activation via FRS2/ARMS and signalling to ERK5, p38 and CREB-dependent transcription, framed as neurotrophin receptor signalling through Ras-MAPK and PI3K/AKT.

theme: Cytochrome P450 xenobiotic and natural product metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe oxidative metabolism of drugs, mycotoxins, alkaloids and plant compounds, framed as phase I detoxification and bioactivation alongside alcohol oxidation.

theme: Mitotic chromosome segregation, spindle checkpoint and cytokinesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe sister chromatid cohesion and separation, spindle assembly checkpoint and PLK1/Aurora/NEK kinase control, framed as the chromosome segregation step that precedes spindle elongation and cytokinetic ring division.

theme: Microglial phagocytic clearance of apoptotic cells and amyloid
core_role: The shared pathways describe apoptotic cell recognition and engulfment, amyloid-beta clearance and microglial activation, framed as microglial housekeeping regulated by microglial proliferation, migration and lysosomal function.

theme: Ionotropic and G protein-mediated synaptic transmission
core_role: The shared pathways describe kainate and AMPA receptor activation, GIRK channels and Gbeta-gamma inhibition of calcium channels, framed as fast and modulatory neurotransmitter receptor signalling alongside nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

theme: tRNA aminoacylation, modification and translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways describe cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging, wybutosine and wobble modifications and diphthamide on EEF2, framed as fidelity of translation machinery with protein hydroxylation as a further post-translational modification.

theme: IL-17 and IL-36 driven antimicrobial barrier immunity
core_role: The shared pathways describe IL-17 production, Th17 commitment and IL-36/IL-38 signalling, framed as cytokine circuits that induce antimicrobial peptide production for antibacterial defence.

theme: Trans-synaptic adhesion in synapse assembly
core_role: The shared pathways describe neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion and pre/postsynaptic membrane assembly, framed as trans-synaptic organiser complexes that build synapses and tune excitatory transmission.

theme: Adipogenesis and nuclear receptor control of lipid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways describe white adipocyte differentiation, PPARG, LXR and SREBP transcriptional control of lipogenesis, triglyceride and gluconeogenesis, framed as transcriptional regulation of energy storage that also touches beta-cell proliferation.

theme: Lipid modification and secretion of Wnt and Hedgehog morphogens
core_role: The shared pathways describe PORCN-mediated Wnt and HHAT-mediated Hedgehog lipidation and secretion, framed as one case of protein palmitoylation/depalmitoylation controlling protein localisation.

theme: Core circadian clock transcriptional feedback loop
core_role: The shared pathways describe the BMAL1:CLOCK-CRY:PER feedback loop, ROR/REV-ERB regulation and entrainment, framed as the molecular clock that times metabolic outputs like beta-cell, thermogenesis and glucocorticoid signalling.

theme: p75NTR and Trk neurotrophin signalling in survival and death
core_role: The shared pathways describe proNGF/NGF processing, p75NTR-mediated death and survival signalling and dependence receptor apoptosis, framed as the cell-death and survival arm opposite TRKA-driven growth and differentiation signalling.

theme: Death receptor-mediated extrinsic apoptosis and necroptosis
core_role: The shared pathways describe FAS and TRAIL death receptor signalling, caspase-8 activation, c-FLIP inhibition and BID cleavage, framed as the apoptotic branch of death receptor signalling that, when caspase-8 is blocked, switches to RIPK-driven necroptosis.

theme: Epithelial-mesenchymal signalling in branching organ morphogenesis
core_role: The shared pathways describe epithelial bud elongation and branching with mesenchymal proliferation and reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signalling across glands, lung and limb, framed as the general branching mechanism underlying lung and airway development.

theme: Heart morphogenesis and cardiac lineage development
core_role: The shared pathways describe myocardial, endocardial, septal, valve and outflow vessel morphogenesis and cardiomyocyte differentiation, framed as chamber and septum formation following heart field specification, heart tube patterning and conduction system development.

theme: Renal electrolyte transport and cell volume regulation
core_role: The shared pathways describe cation-chloride cotransporters, potassium channels and renal sodium/chloride/magnesium handling with Bartter and Gitelman syndromes, framed as ion transport underlying epithelial salt reabsorption and osmotic/cell volume regulation.

theme: Axon guidance by ephrin, netrin and L1 cues
core_role: The shared pathways describe ephrin and netrin/DCC attractive and repulsive signalling, growth cone collapse, RAC1 activation and fasciculation, framed as guidance cue signalling working with L1-family adhesion molecules to steer axons.
